notes: New: setup in two steps (Full Disk Access, then the background helper, added in macOS's own window; Cancel skips it), and one approval now covers your removals and Undo for 5 minutes. App Store and installer apps can now be removed (macOS asks for your approval). Hidden folders an app keeps in your home folder, such as ~/.ollama, now show up in the review (removing them is Pro), and every Pro item is shown locked, by name and size, so you can see what Pro would remove. Uninstalling an app now also stops the background helpers built into it. Fixed: in 1.4 the background helper couldn't switch or remove system startup items, and Uninstall Pangalin Uninstaller… couldn't remove it; both work now. In 1.5.1: nothing is scanned until you accept the terms; App Store and installer apps are moved before their system leftovers, so a refused removal changes nothing; clearer free and Pro wording (scanning for leftovers of deleted apps is free; Pro descriptions now include hidden folders); items nobody can remove, such as installer receipt records, are no longer counted as Pro; a free AI explanation is counted only when an answer arrives; during a licence's grace days you can paste your renewal key; Pangalin Uninstaller's own helper no longer appears in the Startup tab; and update checks send nothing about your Mac, not even the app or macOS version. In 1.5.2: “What is this app?” can use your 3 free explanations on the free version (Pro makes explanations unlimited). In 1.5.3: “What is this app?” always describes the app you selected (it could show the answer for an app you looked at before), and the sparkle on each app row works on the free version too. Updated Licence Terms (2026-10-08).
